_comment: Source of truth for Pale Blue Nexus guests. Used by scripts/update-feed.mjs to build the Guests showcase, per-guest promo share pages, and to map YouTube videos -> guests for performance ranking. Add a new guest here (with their episode youtubeId) and the homepage + promo pages regenerate automatically. New channel episodes are also auto-detected on each scheduled run and appended here as drafts (needsReview: true) for you to review.

guests.name: Jim Rogers
guests.quote: The most important thing to learn is what you love.
guests.bio: Co-founder of the Quantum Fund with George Soros. Returned 4,200% over ten years. Wrote Investment Biker and Adventure Capitalist after traveling through 116 countries. Now based in Singapore, still investing globally.
guests.episodeTitle: Legendary investor. Co-founder of the Quantum Fund with George Soros. The man who went around the world twice on a motorcycle and a car.

guests.name: Jack Couch
guests.role: Founder, Sophtron. Former Global VP of Payments, Xero.
guests.quote: Sales is dead. Podcasts are how trust gets built now.
guests.bio: Founder of Sophtron, building the open financial internet. Former Global VP of Payments at Xero. Founded Monchilla (acquired by Xero) and DeepIntel Solutions. A distribution operator who believes podcasts are the last channel where trust compounds.
guests.episodeTitle: Founder of Sophtron. The man building the open financial internet. On why sales is dead and podcasts are the new trust machine.

guests.name: Austin Armstrong
guests.role: CEO, Syllaby. Managing Partner, Bullhouse Ventures.
guests.quote: The 40-hour work week is kind of BS.
guests.bio: More than 4 million followers across social media. CEO and co-founder of Syllaby, an AI startup helping creators produce, schedule, and publish video at speed. Managing Partner at Bullhouse Ventures. Best-selling author of VIRALITY!
guests.episodeTitle: CEO of Syllaby. Managing Partner, Bullhouse Ventures. 5 million followers across social media. The man who bet his agency on the AI wave and won.

guests.name: Nikola Borisov
guests.quote: Inference infrastructure is where the real compute war is fought.
guests.bio: DeepInfra just closed a $107M Series B led by 500 Global, with NVIDIA and Samsung Next participating. The company processes nearly 5 trillion tokens per week across its own GPU infrastructure in 8 US data centers and supports 190+ open-source models.
guests.episodeTitle: Co-founder & CEO of DeepInfra. Serving 5 trillion AI tokens a week across 8 US data centers. The man building the inference layer that enterprise AI runs on.

guests.name: Nectarios Economakis
guests.role: Partner, Amiral Ventures. Co-founder, The PNR.
guests.bio: Twenty years inside the Canadian tech ecosystem. First BD hire at Google Montreal, where he helped drive 50% year-over-year growth from 2011. Co-founded The PNR. Now Partner at Amiral Ventures, an early-stage and growth venture fund based in Montreal.
guests.episodeTitle: Inside a New $40M Fund Built to Fix Canada's Brain Drain

guests.name: Charles Cormier
guests.bio: Founder and CEO of TopLeads. Builds AI-leveraged go-to-market and sales systems, and writes about how small teams compound output with AI rather than replacing the humans behind it.
guests.episodeTitle: The Power Broker Thesis: Why Charles Cormier Is Betting on Humans, Not Agents

guests.name: Eliza Blank
guests.role: CEO, The Farmlink Project. Founder, The Sill.
guests.bio: Thirteen years building The Sill, the houseplant company that put 'plant parent' into the cultural vocabulary. Twelve stores, $25M raised, exited in 2024. Now CEO of The Farmlink Project, which moved 150 million pounds of rescued produce in 2025.
guests.episodeTitle: The Logistics of Saving Food: Inside The Farmlink Project

guests.name: Haren Bhakta, CFA
guests.bio: Founder and CEO of Inside Ownership Index (OWN), built on the idea that companies with deep insider ownership outperform the market. A CFA charterholder who previously led product at Dapper Labs (NBA Top Shot, Flow blockchain).
guests.episodeTitle: Why the S&P Buys More of a Company After Its Founder Dies

guests.name: Steve Gullans, PhD
guests.role: CEO, Thynk Inc. Co-founder, Excel Venture Management.
guests.bio: Eighteen years on Harvard Medical School faculty, 130+ scientific papers, AAAS Fellow. Co-founder of Excel Venture Management. Co-author of Evolving Ourselves with Juan Enriquez. Now CEO of Thynk Inc, applying cognitive training to ADHD and brain performance.
guests.episodeTitle: You Can Train Your Brain to Flow on Command

guests.name: Mary Grove
guests.bio: Managing Partner at Bread & Butter Ventures, backing founders building beyond the coasts. Previously founded and led Google for Startups, supporting entrepreneurs across more than 135 countries.
guests.episodeTitle: 75% of VC Dollars Go to 3 Cities. She Left for Minnesota.

guests.name: Vitaly Golomb
guests.role: Investor and author of Accelerated Startup.
guests.bio: Global investor, operator, and author of the bestseller Accelerated Startup. Former head of HP Tech Ventures, he has mentored and backed startups across dozens of countries.
guests.episodeTitle: Past Industrial Revolutions Took 100 Years. This One Takes 10.

guests.name: Vadim Peskov
guests.bio: Co-founder and CEO of Diffco, a Silicon Valley software studio building AI and mobile products. A veteran engineer who argues that better models don't automatically mean better software.
guests.episodeTitle: Why This Veteran Engineer Says Better Models Don't Mean Better Software

guests.name: Matt Blumberg
guests.bio: CEO of Markup AI, building AI agents that keep enterprise content accurate and on-brand. A serial entrepreneur, he previously founded and led Return Path and co-founded Bolster, and is the author of Startup CEO.
guests.episodeTitle: Content Is the Next Code: Inside the Rise of AI Guardian Agents.

guests.name: Victor Lugli
guests.bio:
Victor Lugli is managing partner of the Lugli Group, an organisation that operates globally in the fields of Investment, Consulting and Corporate Training.

His business activities have led him to spearhead ventures in 29 countries, and he has been honoured on numerous occasions by international television stations such as RAI - Radio Televisione Italiana, RTS - Radio Télévision Suisse and CNN - Cable News Network. His scientific profile includes the production of pioneering peer-reviewed publications, as well as innovative Italian university textbooks.

His avant-garde vision in conducting business has earned him invitations to join global leaders and present his ideas in Davos, and his most recent activities in the Middle East include negotiating financial stakes in Giga Projects as part of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia's Institutional Investors Programme.
guests.episodeTitle: The Neuroscientist Investor Who Says AI Isn't Intelligent | Victor Lugli
